name: Helion Manufacturing Cable-Management Harness
description:
A torso-worn harness with integrated cable routing channels, clip points, and strain-relief loops designed for technicians who work with multiple data cables, power feeds, and diagnostic lines simultaneously. The harness keeps cables organized, untangled, and secured against the body during movement through tight maintenance corridors.

A mundane but essential accessory for anyone who has tripped over their own cabling in a crawlspace and learned the hard way that cable management is a survival skill when you are thirty meters inside a ventilation shaft.
functionality: Cable organization, strain relief, hands-free cable management
what_it_says: You work in spaces where tripping on a cable could mean falling off a catwalk, and you have solved that problem permanently.
story_hooks: A Cable-Management Harness found in a restricted server room still has three cables clipped to it — each one spliced with data-intercept taps that were recording traffic from three separate corponation networks simultaneously.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Proprioceptive Lattice Sleeve

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian cross-body harness that wraps around the torso and shoulders, creating a geometric web of routing channels and attachment points. When worn, it presents a functional, almost tactical silhouette that suggests competence and technical expertise. The harness sits flush against the chest and sides, with multiple rigid guide tubes and elastic restraint loops creating visual texture across the body.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fitted to the torso with adjustable side-buckle straps that allow for layering over work shirts or directly against skin. Designed to stay secure during crawling, climbing, and lateral movement through confined spaces. The shoulder cross-straps distribute weight evenly and prevent cable load from pulling the wearer off-balance.
physical_description.primary_material: High-grade ballistic weave reinforced with embedded rigid polymer routing channels and medical-grade silicone strain-relief loops. The base is a breathable nylon composite with sweat-wicking treatment.
physical_description.texture: Tactile and industrial—the weave has a subtle ribbed texture, while the integrated channels create hard edges and geometric ridges. Strain loops feel slightly elastic and cool to the touch. Multiple wear surfaces show reinforced stitching at stress points.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal gray base with high-visibility phosphorescent lime green accent piping on all cable channels and attachment loops. Logos and manufacturers markings in brushed steel gray.
physical_description.closures: Quick-release magnetic snaps at the shoulders, friction-fit side-buckles with tool-accessible adjustment tabs, and friction-lock clip points for cable retention throughout the harness body.
distinctive_features: Integrated rigid polymer tubes that guide cables along the spine and ribcage
Quick-release magnetic snap shoulders for fast removal without undressing completely
Color-coded channel sections (green for data, orange accent for power, blue for diagnostic)
Strain-relief silicone loops spaced every 10 centimeters to prevent cable kinking
Tool-accessible side-buckles designed for one-handed adjustment in darkness
Embossed Helion Manufacturing logo on left shoulder
Reinforced stress points at shoulders, sides, and waist with triple-stitching
Subcutaneous biolink anchor points hidden beneath interior padding for augmentation integration
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional—a working-class tool worn by technicians, maintenance contractors, and field engineers. Not luxury, not salvage, but honest gear that signals technical competence and years in the crawlspaces.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by GLMZ infrastructure maintenance workers, freelance technicians, corporate field service engineers, and anyone who spends time inside Iowan Behemoth chassis doing diagnostics or repair work. Marks the wearer as someone who knows their way through the mechanical guts of the city—a specialized trade skill. Also worn by military field-repair units and black-market augmentation technicians.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically worn broken-in, with faint cable abrasion marks on the channels, small stress cracks in the polymer tubes from repeated use, and slight discoloration from sweat and industrial residue. Rarely pristine; always functional.
